title: eriogonum cithariforme var. agninum
intro: Eriogonum cithariforme var. agninum, commonly known as a desert trumpet, is a type of flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The health benefits of this plant are largely anecdotal, but it is said to have anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in the relief of symptoms such as pain and swelling. As for therapeutic actions, Eriogonum cithariforme var. agninum is thought to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can help to protect against infections and promote overall health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
